newsitem.title: CHINA: China Daya Bay generates 6.8 mln mwt/hrs Jan-July.
newsitem.headline: China Daya Bay generates 6.8 mln mwt/hrs Jan-July.

text.p: China's Daya Bay nuclear power plant in southern Guangdong province generated 6.774 million megawatt hours in the first seven months of 1997, the China Daily said on Monday.
Of the total, 6.44 million megawatt hours were transmitted into the national grid, up by 612,000 megawatt hours compared with the year-ago period, it said.
Officials at the plant, which provides about one-fifth of Hong Kong's electric power, estimated it would generate 12 million megawatt hours in 1997, it said.
Total investment in the plant was $4.07 billion, and it now earns about $700 million a year, it said.
